QuestInfo.name: Second Gift from Mastema
QuestInfo.0: Mastema has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Mastema has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: Mastema has given you an Emblem as a gift.

0.0: You're not at your peak, but you're much closer than before. I'm happy for you. It's an honor to witness you regain your powers, #b#ho##k.
0.1: I also got you a celebratory gift, with the hope that it will help you grow stronger. I made this one with even better materials than before, so it should have a greater resonance with your own powers.

no.0: Oh. I'm sure it would be useful to you, #ho#...

yes.0: #b#ho##k, the path you walk will be fraught with dilemmas and hardships. But through that, I will always be here to help you.
